rationale: With only 4 minutes to close, any position opened now faces forced market liquidation at the close, creating unacceptable slippage risk on a stock that has already dropped sharply (gap down ~6% from prior close, trading near session lows). The last candle shows a spike to $33.74 but price is still well below VWAP and the 9-EMA, with no clear directional conviction sufficient to justify a 4-minute trade given the wide intraday range and elevated volatility. The risk/reward does not support entry in either direction this close to the forced close.
